meta.name: dotnet-test
meta.description: This skill should be used when running .NET tests selectively with a build-first, test-targeted workflow. Use it for running tests with xUnit focus.

copy.tagline: 按需运行 .NET 测试，支持 xUnit
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 .NET 项目中运行 xUnit 测试
copy.tagline_en: Run .NET tests selectively with build-first workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run xUnit tests in .NET projects

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先构建整个 .NET 解决方案，然后用 --no-build 运行指定测试项目的测试，并支持按 FullyQualifiedName、DisplayName 等属性筛选，只执行匹配的测试用例。还能调整输出详细程度。
howto.when: 当用户要求运行 .NET 测试、按方法/类名筛选、过滤 xUnit Theory 测试参数、或调试测试问题时触发。

say.text: 运行 UserServiceTests 类中的所有测试。
say.note: Claude 会构建项目并执行该类下的全部测试。

say.text: 只运行名称包含 'Create' 的测试。
显示 OrderTests 中参数为 USD 的 Theory 测试结果。
say.note: 使用 DisplayName 过滤器并显示详细输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first build the entire .NET solution, then run tests from a specified test project using --no-build, and support filtering by FullyQualifiedName, DisplayName, etc. to execute only matching test cases. It can also adjust verbosity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to run targeted .NET tests, filter by method/class name, filter xUnit Theory tests by parameter values, or debug test failures/hangs.

say_en.text: Run all tests in the UserServiceTests class.
say_en.note: Claude will build and execute all tests in that class.

say_en.text: Run only tests with 'Create' in their method name.
Show Theory tests in OrderTests with parameter 'USD'.
say_en.note: Uses DisplayName filter with detailed output.
